name: project-kit
description: Samuel Letellier-Duchesne's plugins for setting up and maintaining software projects, and for reviewing scientific code for correctness.

plugins.name: project-kit
plugins.description: Create, audit and upgrade projects from the project-kit-cookiecutter templates, and maintain their changelogs, releases, pull requests and documentation.

plugins.name: sci-review
plugins.description: Review code for scientific correctness with a panel of independent reviewers: mathematics, numerical stability, physical modelling and units, statistics, and algorithms.
